description: Na₃Ir(NO₂)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.36 Å) and three longer (2.40 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and face-sharing NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are six shorter (2.66 Å) and six longer (2.95 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ir is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent N atoms. All Ir-N bond lengths are 2.09 Å. N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Ir and two O atoms. Both N-O bond lengths are 1.25 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom.
